text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
One day, I notice Мэдзиро МакКуин
looking a little
more worn out than
usual.

I decide to take her to the cafeteria to
relax after
our training.

I appreciate this very much, Trainer. I'm
feeling a
bit better now, thanks to you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Do you have any idea why you're feeling tired?

text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, my study session
last night
was a little lengthier than
usual.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to rely on my roommate,
Ikuno, as I
usually do.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I usually turn to Ikuno for help whenever
I get
stuck with my studies.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Not only is she studious, but she's also
very caring
of others.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
However... recently she's been forgoing
races.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I do wish she would pay more mind to
her own
dreams. I say this not only as a
friend, but as a
rival.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Just as I'm about to respond...
Oh?
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Hello, Мэдзиро МакКуин and her trainer. I
hope
your day has been going well.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
I believe I heard my name being
mentioned. Do
you need anything?
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! We weren't discussing
anything
important.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
How mortifying... I hope she didn't
overhear our
conversation!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин only wants Ikuno
Dictus to focus
on running, but her
intentions might go
misinterpreted. I
need to divert the conversation

somehow.
choice_data_list: She was talking about how you're a good friend.
She wants you to focus on your dream.

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин only wants Ikuno
Dictus to focus
on running, but her
intentions might go
misinterpreted. I
need to divert the conversation

somehow.
choice_data_list: She was talking about how you're a good friend.
She wants you to focus on your dream.

text_block_list.text: ...I am?
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Well if friends are what we're talking
about, I find
Мэдзиро МакКуин to be a
wonderful example.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
While some tend toward defiance when
given
advice, McQueen is always very
receptive.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
It's a great help when I'm out there
looking after
everyone.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I've come to notice these
traits in
Мэдзиро МакКуин too. She's
sincere and dutiful.
choice_data_list: I think I get what you mean.

text_block_list.text: Oh... Really?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd agree! McQueen isn't only
diligent,
she's also hardworking and a
fast learner. What's
more...
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus unexpectedly breaks into
her
management spiel.

...And that is all. Thank you for this
valuable
conversation, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Whenever you have time, I would like to
continue
our discussion.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
P-please stop... The two of you get much
too
carried away.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
That's enough talk about me. I would
like you to
focus more on yourself,
Ikuno.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. However,
I'm taking
well enough care of myself, so
don't you worry.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: H-hey now! That was a little too direct!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Hehe. I appreciate it.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
However, you needn't worry yourself. I
always
take care not to exceed my
limits. Now what I'm
more concerned
about is...
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
McQueen, is everything all right? I ask
because
you appear quite tired.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Y-you needn't worry yourself! I'm
perfectly fine,
really!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well if it isn't necessary, then
I shan't
inquire any further.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
No! I don't mean to say that it isn't
necessary...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It seems Мэдзиро МакКуин feels a mixture
of both
gratitude and guilt about Ikuno
Dictus's care and
attention.
choice_data_list:
She's probably feeling bad because she makes
you worry a lot.

text_block_list.text: Hey!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I-I did not say anything to that extent!
Would you
please stop speaking for me
as if I were a child!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Oh... Is that the case?
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Then I shall respect your wishes. I will
refrain from
being too attentive since it
bothers you so.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: Oh, please! Not you as well, Ikuno!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Whereas Мэдзиро МакКуин shies from
receiving
compliments, Ikuno Dictus
accepts them coolly. I
feel like I've
caught a glimpse of how their

relationship works.

Seeing Мэдзиро МакКуин get flustered,
Ikuno
Dictus simply smiles.
